title: Tipping Settings for Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Tipping settings for Cartwise Grocery Orders

Whether a Cartwise Grocery Orders order carries a shopper tip, the tip preselected at checkout, and the limits on changing it after completion are fixed per service level.

| Service level | Tip carried | Tip preselected at checkout (percent of item subtotal) | Tip edit window after completion | Tip changes allowed after completion | Largest single increase after completion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | no | 0 | 0 hours | 0 | 0.00 USD |
| No-Rush Delivery | yes | 5 | 24 hours | 1 | 100.00 USD |
| Standard Delivery | yes | 5 | 24 hours | 1 | 100.00 USD |
| Priority Delivery | yes | 5 | 24 hours | 1 | 100.00 USD |
| Express 30 Delivery | yes | 5 | 24 hours | 1 | 100.00 USD |
| Stock-Up Delivery | yes | 5 | 48 hours | 1 | 200.00 USD |

## Notes

- **Tip carried** — Curbside Pickup orders carry no tip; every delivery service level does.
- **Preselected tip** — the percentage of the item subtotal preselected as the tip at checkout.
- **Edit window** — the number of hours after completion during which the tip can be changed.
- **Changes allowed** — how many tip changes may be made after completion.
- **Largest single increase** — the biggest single tip increase accepted after completion.

## Hypothetical figures

- An item subtotal of 80.00 USD at Standard Delivery gives a preselected tip of 5 percent, that is 4.00 USD.
- A Stock-Up Delivery order completed at 09:30 on a given day has a 48-hour edit window; a Standard Delivery order completed at the same moment has a 24-hour one.
